metadata.description:
A quiet gem tucked into South Minneapolis, Lake Hiawatha offers peaceful paths, birdwatching hideaways, and a golf course next door. It may not make as much noise as its bigger siblings, but it holds its own with calm waters and a down-to-earth charm. Locals know it as a spot to fish, relax, or quietly recharge. Collect this Lake Lover POAP for discovering the subtle beauty on your 612 POAP Challenge journey. 

Category: Lake Lover
